notes: v284 — PEGS-SEEDS-NOT-FENCES (Oct 29, 2026, owner feedback 14:38 MDT, approved 14:55). The owner: tight fixed peg circles are a double-edged sword — on same-site jobs the pickup and dump spots MOVE around the site load to load, so a tight fence works some days and not others, and re-pegging every load means touching the screen again and again: tiresome and dangerous. BUILD: the pegs are SEEDS, not fences. (1) js/geoloads.js — createPegCounter re-founded: each role keeps a living CENTRE starting at its seed peg; every COUNTED event (a confirmed pickup, a counted dump) nudges the centre toward the event smoothed position by at most DRIFT_STEP_M 25 m, so the work face can wander all day with zero screen touches and one bad fix can never teleport a centre; the pull is evidence-gated (a spot nearer the OTHER centre beyond the tie band moves nothing) and clamped inside the site frame. The fence is PEG_FENCE_M 70 m (his 60-80 m band). Identity comes from the load->dump->load CYCLE: the ambiguity rule — a dwell in only one fence belongs to that role (unexpected alone = a visit, no count, no arm change); a dwell in BOTH fences belongs to the nearer centre, EXCEPT when the truck is >= TIE_MIN_DIST_M 20 m from BOTH centres and the distances are within TIE_BAND_M 10 m, where geometry is a coin flip and the cycle expected role wins (cfg.tieRole on the standard counter, additive; its moveSites() moves fences in place, other counters untouched). A wide SITE frame is derived from the seeds alone (midpoint; radius max(200, half the seed separation + 100); a lone seed frames itself at 250 m): a smoothed fix outside it never reaches the zone machine — an off-site stop counts nothing whatever its length (place, not duration). A re-peg RE-SEEDS with v282 banking preserved. Centres + counted-event positions ride the snapshot (pegCentres / pegEvents) and the day record (rec.pegEvents via basePegEvents across re-seeds/sessions; rec.pegCentres; forDate surfaces both). Dwell 30 s and the 30 m accuracy bar carry over from v282; no-peg days run the inference stack untouched. (2) modules/manifest.js — pegPlaceLabels merges the day counted pegEvents into each role place sequence by time: Loaded at / Dumped at read the seed place, then each distinctly-named place the work actually moved into, in order, never coordinates; an unnamed event place prints its event time (Loaded — 3:05 PM); pre-v284 days render byte-for-byte as v283. HARNESS: NEW tools/pegs-seeds-v284-test.js 34/34 — (a) faces drift ~60 m in steps, 4/4 cycles count with NO re-peg, centres follow; (b) faces converge 300 -> ~100 m over 5 cycles, exactly 5 counted, no phantoms, centres stay distinct; (c) a 5-minute stop 400 m off site mid-cycle counts nothing, keeps the arm, drifts nothing, and the interrupted cycle still completes; (d) mid-day re-seed banks the count and extends the event trail across both jobs; (e) the site-frame formula (wide pair ~850, 15 m pair floor 200, lone seed 250, unarmed); (m) the manifest under drift (named sequence + printed line + no coordinates + unnamed event time fallback). REGRESSIONS: pegs-v282 26/26 (the first build of this item FAILED its case (b) 21-count runaway — pure expectation attribution lets a stationary truck in a full overlap alternate the cycle by itself; the shipped rule keeps nearer-wins outside the coin-flip band, and the suite is the proof), manifest-peg-places-v283 22/22, geofence 58/58, learning 32/32, v140 38/38, v267 19/19, v268 16/16, batch-v220 36/36, dispatch-shiftclose 46/46, manual-start-law 33/33, live-drive 69/69; manifest family at the v283 baseline counts (export 61/0, gps-data 31/31, home-stops 14/14, pti 19/19, odo 31/31, odo-end 9/9, times 19/19, edit 22/22, route 8/8; multiday 26/2, names 16/1, toggles 48/49 — stale pins identical on the pristine tree).
